aivv73/entangle — public

I’ll move it to the public repository `aivv73/entangle`. One dependency still points to Entire, so I’m checking whether its pinned version is available on GitHub too. I’m using the prove-it-works skill to verify the migration with a fresh clone.

GitHub’s copy of `bend-vulkan` is six commits behind the version Entangle needs. I’ll publish that exact version on a dedicated dependency branch and update Entangle’s clone instructions, using the technical-writing skill. GitHub will become `origin`, and the old Entire remote will remain available.
